crossRefs.note: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.
If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place…
If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.
But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by…
But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

translations.kjv: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
